notes.title: Now with Continues!
notes.notes:
Attention, soldiers! To help in the battle, the General decided to release the use of continues.

Teddy barked his approval, so let's go to battle!

notes.title: The demo is now released!
notes.notes:
[b]It's time to rock, soldier![/b]

Experience the beginning of Major Williams and Teddy's journey in this action-packed demo! Defeat the slimy aliens without fear and without worrying about the consequences.

[i]This is an ongoing project, please leave your feedback to help us improve the game. :)
(Oh, and if you liked it, don't forget to add it to your wishlist.)[/i]
